2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch removes the lru_gen_soft_reclaim() function and the associated operation (MEMCG_LRU_HEAD) from the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) implementation. The reason for this removal is that the soft limit rbtree was the only caller of this function, and dropping it makes the MEMCG_LRU_HEAD operation unreachable. As a result, the patch also updates the memcg LRU comment to reflect the remaining operations. This change simplifies the code and reduces complexity.
